title: Every Way Nature Gets Inside Doug (Parasites, Venom and Fungi Marathon)
card: EVERY WAY NATURE GETS INSIDE DOUG
intro: Doug has been invaded from the inside more times than anyone should be. Parasites, venoms, brain worms and fungi. Here they all are, back to back. He did not agree to any of this.
description: Four full episodes, back to back: every parasite, every deadly venom, every brain parasite and the most disturbing fungi ever found, and Doug hosts all of them. Real science, cartoon deaths.
